title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 102 ]

blocks.text: Competition is an important part of development in many ways. At the personal level, competition allows us to become the best individual we can be. By competing with others in sports, for example, we can raise our level of athletic performance. In business, competition controls the market by making companies develop new ideas to ensure survival. Within industries, companies are always trying to develop products that are one step better than those of other companies. For those who fail to compete successfully, their very survival can be in question.

readingSentences.english: Competition is an important part of development in many ways.
readingSentences.korean: 경쟁이란 여러 면에서 발전의 중요한 부분이다.

readingSentences.english: At the personal level, competition allows us to become the best individual we can be.
readingSentences.korean: 개인적 차원에서 경쟁은 우리가 될 수 있는 최고의 사람이 되게 한다.

readingSentences.english: By competing with others in sports, for example, we can raise our level of athletic performance.
readingSentences.korean: 예를 들면, 스포츠에서 우리는 다른 사람들과 경쟁함으로써 우리의 운동 능력 수준을 높일 수 있다.

readingSentences.english: In business, competition controls the market by making companies develop new ideas to ensure survival.
readingSentences.korean: 사업에서 경쟁은 여러 회사들이 생존하기 위해 새로운 아이디어를 개발하도록 하여 시장을 조절한다.

readingSentences.korean: 산업 분야에서 회사들은 항상 다른 회사보다 한 단계 나은 제품을 개발하려고 노력한다.

readingSentences.english: For those who fail to compete successfully, their very survival can be in question.
